Subjects

The five CSCA subject pathways

Use the subject overview to understand the structure of the exam before moving into syllabus reading, practice, mock tests, and route-specific decisions.

Browse the five subject pathways

These subject cards are the main entrance. Go straight into the subject that matches your route, then continue into syllabus pages, mock tests, and route-specific decisions.

Subject

Math

Core subject for most applicants, with a strong focus on foundational quantitative ability.

60 min · 48 questions · CN/EN

Subject

Physics

Often required for engineering, computer science, and many STEM pathways.

60 min · 48 questions · CN/EN

Subject

Chemistry

Important for medicine, biological sciences, and chemistry-related programs.

60 min · 48 questions · CN/EN

Subject

Humanities Chinese

For government-scholarship or Chinese-taught humanities, arts, law, education, and social science routes.

90 min · objective questions · CN

Subject

STEM Chinese

For government-scholarship or Chinese-taught STEM, engineering, science, and medicine pathways.

90 min · objective questions · CN

Core Structure

5 subject pathways

General Logic

Major + language + route shape subject needs

Best Use

Start here before route-specific planning

How subject selection usually works

Math is one of the strongest anchor subjects across many routes.

Science-heavy routes usually make physics or chemistry more relevant.

Chinese Government Scholarship undergraduate applicants take Professional Chinese regardless of teaching language; other Chinese-taught routes often add it as an academic requirement.

Where to go next

Once a user understands the subject structure, the next move should usually be syllabus reading, practice, or mock-test preparation. Route tools still matter, but they should not overpower the prep path.
